//: Copy to eidan.deploy.json (gitignored) and edit. `bundles` lists the opt-in plugin packages a target loads; `targets` are where you ship.
//bundles-note: Eidan's own thematic bundles live IN this repo under packages/<name> (AGPL, tracked). List them SOURCELESS — just name (+ kinds) — to include them in a target's plugin set without vendoring. Add a `path`/`git` source ONLY for your OWN external plugin repo (it gets vendored into packages/<name> at assemble time).

bundles.//external-example: your own plugin from a local path or git:

//catalogue: The bundle catalogue the wizard's 'Add a bundle' picks from lives in its OWN gitignored file eidan.catalogue.json (so it survives a from-zero re-init and keeps any private repo names out of tracked code). Copy eidan.catalogue.example.json to start.
//providers: optional provider catalogue (overrides deploy/manifest.mjs DEFAULT_PROVIDERS). Each: { module, endpoint, model, key:<ENV name|null> }. Targets pick from these by name.
//targets: Each target's CAPABILITIES (the manifest): `eidan compile <target>` renders its matbot.yaml (plugins+providers) + env from these. Run the wizard (eidan-cli.mjs) instead of hand-editing.

pi-node.//: ssh-node: engine as a node process under systemd. CAPABILITIES below are the manifest; `eidan compile pi-node` renders its matbot.yaml + env from them.
pi-node.//run_user: runtime user the systemd service runs as (User=); owns ~/.claude, git identity, WorkingDirectory. Defaults to the SSH user. Used by `provision`.
pi-node.//caps: plugins: '*'|[bundle names] (core always on); providers: [from catalogue]; models: '*'|[ids]; jobs: kinds served; domain/cors.

vercel.//: Web/Next.js front door on Vercel. Values live in apps/web/.env (schema role 'web'); set the same in the Vercel dashboard or `vercel env`. No matbot.yaml (runs the Next app, not the engine).
vercel.//domain: → EIDAN_WEB_URL (the public URL). //engine: which engine target the web proxies to → EIDAN_ENGINE_URL. Both derived at compile.
